items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Dr. Mayer came out to my house and gave me exercises for seven weeks to get me prepared to get up out of bed.

ctx.x: -- I come out for convalescing. My doctor came to my house -- something unusual -- I'm living in Long Island, Jamaica, that is, Brick Town, and Dr. Mayer came out to my house and gave me exercises for seven weeks to get me prepared to get up out of bed. He tested my spine with his thumb going down to see if I felt any pain, and I don't feel it.

So he gave me to lay on my stomach, to flex my back and raise up (inaudible) as hard as I could every hour on the hour. He gave me muscle situations for my legs, and I did this religiously. When I got up, I had one day on the walker, one day. And second day they put me on the crutches, and that's how he got me prepared. Seven weeks -- I didn't even know I'd been in bed.
